usage.source_scope: 用触觉结果回路验证门功能是否真正发生。
usage.project_application: 作为 completion 设计原则：视觉只能提出门/把手动作，完成必须由独立 outcome signal 确认。
usage.modifications: BlindAssist 当前无机器人触觉，故仅保留“结果回执独立于视觉 proposal”的合同，不声称可直接实现 DoorBot。
usage.expected_effect: 阻止把看似正确的动作点或接近姿态误当成门已打开/任务已完成。

evaluation.setup: SceneFun3D 421013 action-geometry mechanics canary; evaluator motion annotations generated fixed 2 cm translations or 5 degree rotations over up to 128 paired functional points with 1.5 mm noise; the causal estimator saw only before/after points.
evaluation.effect: SC14 improved motion-type correctness from 7/8 static to 8/8 causal; translational direction hits from 4/7 to 7/7; mean direction error from 38.89 to 0.91 degrees; the single rotational axis passed and pivot-line error was 2.22 cm.
metrics: translation_direction_hit=4/7 static vs 7/7 causal at 15 degrees
evaluation.claim_boundary: Mechanics-only adaptation of the independent-outcome principle. SceneFun3D generated the motion and evaluator supplied point correspondences; no robot haptics, natural RGB-D tracking, safe user probe, reachability, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, completion, product benefit, or safety was established.

evidence.summary: Primary source reviewed for mechanism and evidence boundary; no BlindAssist reproduction is implied.

history.change: Added from the user-provided directed literature review as a candidate only; no route authority or experimental result was created.

Executed the causal-outcome adaptation after SC12 and SC13 showed that static task/geometry axes were insufficient. The next source must provide natural before/after RGB-D motion or an explicitly authorized benign interaction; static action-axis tuning is closed.
